question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"amorphous​****."****

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"amorphous"** means having no definite shape, form or structure. (बिना किसी निश्चित आकृति, रूप या संरचना के; अनाकार)

 
 
• **Example**: *The **amorphous**__ substance that results from the breakdown of sugar is known as caramel.*
 
 
 
• The paragraph conveys that the home itself appeared to have bent and stretched, while the outside world had turned into an empty, indefinite wasteland.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct paragraph:

Outside, the world had become a formless, __**amorphous**__ with no shape, while the house itself seemed to have twisted and stretched. There was sticky web-stuff ______ (2) ______ to her arm, and she wiped it off as best as she could. The other mother was waiting for her, standing on the grass with her arms ______ (3) ______. Her black button eyes were expressionless, but her lips were pressed tightly in a cold ______ (4) ______. When she saw Myna she reached ______ (5) _______ one long white hand, and she crooked a finger.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Ambiguous: **having more than one possible meaning. (जिसके एक से अधिक अर्थ निकाले जा सकें; अनेकार्थता)
 
• **Advent: **the fact of somebody/something arriving. ((किसी व्‍यक्ति या घटना का) आगमन)
 
• **Ambivalent: **having or showing a mixture of feelings or opinions about something or somebody. (मिश्रित या मिली-जुली भावनाओं से युक्त; उभयमुख)
